_comment: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11th edition) stratagems + detachment rules, generated by
scripts/40kdc/curate-from-wahapedia.mjs from the Wahapedia snapshot in
printed text. windows were INFERRED from WHEN (see _window_review) unless the codex
implementation pass CONFIRMED them (CONFIRMED_WINDOWS in the script, marked [CONFIRMED]).
duration_phrase is editorial (see orks_codex_11e.json; DURATION_PHRASES in the script).
Boarding Actions detachments are out of scope (owner decision D3).

detachments.name: Null Maiden Vigil
detachments.rule_text:
Silent Sisterhood
• When mustering your army, you can select a friendly Anathema Psykana Character model to be your WARLORD.
• Friendly Prosecutor SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
• Friendly Anathema Psykana units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
detachments.legend: NULL MAIDENS COMBINE DREAD POWERS AND MARTIAL SKILL TO DEFEAT THEIR FOES

detachments.name: Auric Champions
detachments.rule_text:
Assemblage of Might
In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly Adeptus Custodes Character models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to wound rolls.
detachments.legend: THE GREATEST OF THE ADEPTUS CUSTODES’ CHAMPIONS SEEK TO SLAY THE MIGHTIEST FOES

detachments.name: Lions of the Emperor
detachments.rule_text:
On Gilded Wings
At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.
detachments.legend: THE CHAMPIONS OF THE THARANATOI ORDER APPEAR IN BURSTS OF GOLDEN LIGHT

detachments.name: Might of the Moritoi
detachments.rule_text:
Moritoi Ancients
• While a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.
• While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
detachments.legend: STRIDING TO WAR, THE MORITOI BRING TO BEAR WEAPONS OF TERRIBLE DESTRUCTION

detachments.name: Shadowkeepers
detachments.rule_text:
Wardens of the Dark Cells
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Favoured ka’tah: Kaptaris
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.
detachments.legend: THE SHADOWKEEPERS SEEK TO DESTROY OR CONTAIN THAT WHICH SHOULD NOT BE

detachments.name: Guardians of the Throne
detachments.rule_text:
Martial Mastery
In the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:
• [Sustained Hits 1].
• Or: [Lethal Hits].
detachments.legend: FEW FOES CAN STAND AGAINST A COMBINED-ARMS FORCE OF CUSTODIANS

detachments.name: Honoured Companions
detachments.rule_text:
Companion’s Watch
While a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

detachments.name: Solar Watch
detachments.rule_text:
Talon Sortie
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.
Favoured ka’tah: Calistus
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.
detachments.legend: GUARDIANS OF THE SOL SYSTEM, THE SOLAR WATCH FAVOUR RAPID WARFARE

detachments.name: Emperor’s Chosen
detachments.rule_text:
Magna Imperator
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.
Favoured ka’tah: Rendax
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:
• On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
detachments.legend: MOST SHIELD HOSTS ARE TEMPORARY, BUT ALL PLAY A VITAL ROLE IN THE EMPEROR’S SERVICE

detachments.name: Emissaries Imperatus
detachments.rule_text:
Heralds of the Throne
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units have Fights First.
Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai
Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
detachments.legend: THE EMISSARIES IMPERATUS WILL GO TO ANY LENGTHS TO DELIVER THE EMPEROR’S WORD

detachments.name: Aquilan Shield
detachments.rule_text:
Gilded Guardians
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Favoured ka’tah: Salvus
Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.
detachments.legend: THE AQUILAN SHIELD ARE AN UNBREAKABLE FORTRESS OF AURAMITE

detachments.name: Grav-Assault Force
detachments.rule_text:
Flare Shields
Friendly grav-assault units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.
detachments.legend: SWIFT AND AGILE, ADEPTUS CUSTODES GRAV-VEHICLES CAN INFLICT UNTOLD DESTRUCTION

detachments.name: Dread Host
detachments.rule_text:
Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units can re-roll charge rolls.
Favoured ka’tah: Dacatarai
Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.
detachments.legend: THE DREAD HOST UNLEASHES THE EMPEROR’S WRATH UPON THE FOE

stratagems.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Prosecutor squad unit has shot.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is prosecuted until the end of the turn:
• Attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.

stratagems.name: PURGATION SWEEP
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Witchseeker squad unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s [Torrent] attacks have:
• +1 A.
• Or: If those attacks target a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +2 A.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The role of the Witchseeker on the battlefield is simple: to reduce their intended targets to ash.

stratagems.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Vigilator squad unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
• [Sustained Hits 1]
• Or: [Lethal Hits].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the blade, demonstrating a skill-at-arms as terrifying as their soulless aura.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if that model is a Character model:
• On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Even as death is certain, the Emperor’s Ten Thousand will not relent, fighting to their last breath in defence of the Golden Throne.

stratagems.name: GILDED CHAMPION
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Character model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one additional time, but not in the same phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.

stratagems.name: FURY OF THE EMPEROR
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: For all their physical might, it is the wrathful fury of the Adeptus Custodes that renders them truly terrifying. This is a gift they owe to the Emperor, who vested them with but a sliver of His terrible fury.

stratagems.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that has 2+ models.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Terminator-armoured Custodian champions fight alone and unaided, engaging entire formations in unrelenting battle.

stratagems.name: VIGIL UNENDING
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: So long as their duty remains unfulfilled, the Adeptus Custodes remain defiant in the face of their opponents.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Mobile.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Few obstacles can impede a Custodian Dreadnought in full flow. Those that do are smashed down to clear a path.

stratagems.name: HONOURED INTERRED
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit has the following ability:
Honoured Interred (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: To fight in the shadow of the Moritoi is inspirational for any Custodian.

stratagems.name: UNCEASING ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect:
• Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn.
• That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Drawing upon the full extent of their organic and mechanical might, this Dreadnought advances with unrelenting aggression, dispensing death with archeotech weaponry and crushing fist alike.

stratagems.name: INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: No volume of fire or aggression will pry the Custodians from their objectives. Those who attempt to do so are subjected to the fullest extent of their violent fury.

stratagems.name: NO ESCAPE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
stratagems.duration_phrase: until the end of the turn
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Those Custodians who have served among the Shadowkeepers pursue their prey with dogged determination and will see them captured or slain.

stratagems.name: GRIM RESPONSIBILITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The Shadowkeepers strive to bring the most monstrous and malevolent of the Emperor’s foes to justice, striking them down with ruthless efficiency.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is readied.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Ever watchful and alert, these warriors switch seamlessly between martial ka’tah.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effect:
When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have:
• -1 to hit rolls.
• -1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Coming to the aid of beleaguered allies, these Custodians issue challenges to their foes. Few possess the resolve to ignore these bellicose cries, and even those who refuse to respond are left shaken.

stratagems.name: UNLIMITED ENDURANCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn:
• Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].
• That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Possessed of great endurance, Custodian sodalities willl pursue their targets to the ends of the galaxy. No matter how hard they might try, none can flee from their wrath.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match. The greatest among them are outstanding, even by these lofty standards.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Even the most potent of attacks struggle to penetrate the auramite plate of these warriors.

stratagems.name: PRIME TARGET
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.
• Re-roll one damage roll.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: When a threat to the Golden Throne is identified, the Adeptus Custodes will bend every fibre of their being to ensure its destruction.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by Character models) have +2 A.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The loss of a single Custodian is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR'S DOMAIN
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect:
You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.
This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: There are those territories that must remain in the hands of the Imperium and be free of foes, regardless of the cost.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match. The greatest among them are outstanding, even by these lofty standards.

stratagems.name: AT SPEAR'S LENGTH
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
stratagems.duration_phrase: until the end of the turn
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Duty to the Golden Throne overrides all else. When called to strike a new target, Custodian sodalities withdraw from the fight in close order, keeping their spears leveled towards their foes and holding them at bay with close-range volleys of bolter fire.

stratagems.name: GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Carried by many Custodians, these explosive devices detonate on impact, creating a field of gravitic energy that immobilises those caught in the blast radius.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• M.
• Advance rolls and charge rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: No obstacle, physical or otherwise, can halt the advance of the Solar Watch, nor stay their wrath.

stratagems.name: IMPENETRABLE BASTION
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: When holding ground, a sodality of Custodians becomes a living fortress whose gilded walls are nigh impossible to breach.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Even the most potent of attacks struggle to penetrate the auramite plate of these warriors.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.when: End of any phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is readied.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Ever watchful and alert, these warriors switch seamlessly between martial ka’tah.

stratagems.name: BEARERS OF HIS LIGHT
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: No matter how far they stray from the Golden Throne, all Custodians carry with them the Emperor’s light, drawing upon His guidance in the midst of battle.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF NIGHTMARES
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s T have +1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: In an age plagued by monstrous foes, primordial horrors from the darkest void circle Humanity’s dying light. These hideous aberrations the Adeptus Custodes engage without hesitation.

stratagems.name: SELFLESS SERVICE
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit within 6" of an enemy unit. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect:
Declare a charge with your unit:
• When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
• When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Any of the Ten Thousand would place themselves in peril to protect a fellow Custodian without a moment’s hesitation.

stratagems.name: RAPID REACTIONS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Forcing their outmatched enemies to fall back, Custodians level their guardian spears and cut down fleeing opponents with volleys of bolter fire.

stratagems.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.
stratagems.duration_phrase: until the end of the turn
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The Adeptus Custodes never take the pressure off their foes, maintaining punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.

stratagems.name: TIP OF THE TALON
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of your unit have +1 S.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Fighting at the forefront of the battle, these Custodians hit their victims with perfectly timed volleys the instant before they tear into their ranks.

stratagems.name: ADVANCED STABILISERS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Adeptus Custodes grav-vehicles possess highly efficient weapon stabilisation systems, enabling them to fire accurately even when travelling at maximum speed.

stratagems.name: VICTORY BEFORE DEATH
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit within range of an objective is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.
stratagems.effect:
Select one objective that:
• Your unit was controlling when it was destroyed.
• Has no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) within range of it.
That objective is secured.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Scrambling from the burning wreckage of their vehicles, Custodian crews use the last of their strength to claim their assigned objectives before succumbing to their wounds.

stratagems.name: INEVITABLE ANNIHILATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• BS.
• Hit rolls.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The preternatural dexterity and reaction times of Custodian pilots and gunners, paired with the superlative targeting augury and terrifying speed of Adeptus Custodes grav-tanks, conspire to ensure that prey have little hope of escaping their fiery doom.

stratagems.name: GOLDEN LIGHT OF THE MOIRAIDES
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make an ingress move.
stratagems.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
• Enemy units cannot target your unit with snap shooting attacks.
stratagems.duration_phrase: until the start of your next Command phase
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The Dread Host goes to battle aboard the trio of terrifying pre-Heresy warships known as the Moiraides. These potent vessels teleport their passengers straight into battle amidst an eruption of dazzling golden light.

stratagems.name: PRETERNATURAL RAPIDITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.
stratagems.effect: That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.duration_phrase: until the end of the turn
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: The warriors of the Adeptus Custodes are relentless in their pursuit of the Throneworld’s foes.

stratagems.name: LIGHTNING WRATH
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a pile-in move.
stratagems.effect: When making that pile-in move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/adeptus-custodes/ (export 2026-10-16 21:03:46). Flavour: Rushing forward with terrifying speed, Custodian sodalities leave their foes no opportunity to escape.
